definitions.explanation: Indicating difficulty or taking a long time.

examples.japanese: なかなか⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧なかなか⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
examples.english: The food at this restaurant is quite delicious.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧なかなか⟦{面白|おもしろ}くて→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧、⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This drama is quite interesting, and I look forward to it every week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧なかなか⟦{分|わ}かりやすくて→わかりやすい：09582_wakariyasui⟧、⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: His explanation was quite easy to understand, so I could follow even difficult topics.

examples.japanese: なかなか⟦{来|こ}ない→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
なかなか⟦{覚|おぼ}えられない→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
⟦{忙|いそが}しくて→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧なかなか⟦{会|あ}えない→会う：00482_au⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: We're so busy that we can't easily meet, can we?

examples.english: Japanese kanji are not easy to memorize.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧なかなか⟦{慣|な}れなくて→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I'm having trouble adjusting to my new job, and every day is tough.

notes:
なかなか changes meaning depending on whether the sentence is affirmative or negative.

WITH AFFIRMATIVES (quite, rather):
Expresses moderate praise or acknowledgment.
- なかなか⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: quite good
- なかなか⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧: fairly skilled
- なかなか⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧: pretty tasty

WITH NEGATIVES (not easily, hardly):
Expresses difficulty or that something takes time.
- なかなか⟦{来|こ}ない→来る：00254_kuru⟧: won't come easily
- なかなか⟦{覚|おぼ}えられない→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧: can't easily memorize
- なかなか⟦{会|あ}えない→会う：00482_au⟧: hard to meet

USAGE:
In positive contexts, なかなか suggests "better than expected" or "surprisingly good." In negative contexts, it conveys mild frustration or resignation about difficulty.
